hints.title: Augmented Grid State
hints.text: Incorporate the orientation of the preceding move into the path state alongside row and column indices.

hints.title: Direction Alternation Enforcement
hints.text: After a horizontal step, only vertical transitions are permitted, and after a vertical step, only horizontal transitions are permitted.

hints.title: Shortest Path Exploration
hints.text: Explore paths in increasing order of accumulated cost to find the minimal cost reaching the bottom-right target.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Augmented state graph search with 3 directional states per grid cell.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Ignoring the alternating constraint permits invalid consecutive collinear steps.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distance matrix of size M x N x 3 memoizes shortest paths per orientation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Augment Dijkstra state with the previous move direction.
